# Give network fixtures valid hostnames without erasing local mailbox cases

Entry 518 removes spaces from artificial POP fixture hostnames but retains the genuine mailbox://nobody@Local%20Folders case and its case-preserving expected host. Current unit table checks spec, host, prePath and other URL parts. Avoid testing an unrelated network flow with display-label strings as hostnames; preserve deliberately nonstandard mailbox compatibility cases. This is a data-validity rule, not CamelCase filename guidance.

Scope: mailnews/local/test/unit.
